messages:
deploy-bot: :information_source: Canary rollout started for service/model-service v2 (rollout_id=roll-20260315-9c). Target: 10% traffic, staged across us-west-2. Docs: https://deploys/internal/roll-20260315-9c

emily: seeing a weird bump on canary d-svc p50 after ~2m. Not many errors but tail latency up. Anyone watching metrics? :eyes:

raj: on it, pulling logs now. which cluster?

emily: canary in us-west-2a, route: rs-model-serve-3, traffic slice: 10%. p50 jumped from 70ms -> 240ms, p95 from 320ms -> 1.2s.

raj: grabbing a sample trace. If it's KV cache churn, we should kill the rollout.

oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for emily (oncall). Incident channel: #incidents/rollout-degradation. Severity: P1 (customer-facing latency regression).

emily: paging because customer-facing latency is affected for a subset of requests. Low error rate but unacceptable latency hit. rolling back?

raj: quick check: kernel logs show increased context switch and a spike of small-batch token requests. Could be new batching change in the new runtime. Running `kubectl logs` on pod rs-model-serve-3-az1 for latest requests.

raj: pastebin of recent logs:
```
2026-03-15T21:14:31Z request_id=abc123 seq_len=64 tokens=180 latency_ms=115
2026-03-15T21:14:32Z request_id=abc124 seq_len=204 tokens=512 latency_ms=980
2026-03-15T21:14:33Z request_id=abc125 seq_len=16 tokens=30 latency_ms=90
2026-03-15T21:14:34Z request_id=abc126 seq_len=512 tokens=1024 latency_ms=1220
```

emily: those long seq_len requests map to a small subset of customers. Paul from CS is looping in support to notify impacted customers. @paul any ETA on that?

paul: noted. I'll prepare a message and wait for confirmation from SRE if we're rolling back.

raj: I can flip the canary back to previous variant in ~30s. Two options: 1) kill rollout and revert traffic to v1, or 2) scale canary to 0 pods then health-check before full revert. Option 1 is fastest.

emily: go with option 1, we need to protect latency. Execute kill-switch and mark RFC for runtime batching change.

raj: executing revert command now: `depctl rollout abort --id roll-20260315-9c --force`

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollout abort acknowledged for roll-20260315-9c. Traffic redirected back to v1 (stable). Estimated full shift: 45s.

emily: confirming metrics — p50 trending back down already. Good. Keep an eye on p95.

oncall-bot: handoff reminder: emily oncall until 22:00 UTC, after that raj will be primary. If emily needs to pass earlier, acknowledge in thread.

raj: I'm keeping a watch on traces and will collect heap/profile if p95 doesn't normalize in 10m. Also collecting sample payloads for the model team.

sre_lead: please capture exact request IDs and any kernel/runtime flags. We'll open a postmortem and include a suggested kill-switch flow in runbooks. Assign to eng-runtime.

paul: CS draft ready, holding to post once SRE confirms no further user impact.

emily: marking incident as mitigated for now. I'll do a quick handoff to @raj at 22:00 UTC. Next steps: postmortem, revert-why, and add canary traffic gating for sequence-length heuristics.

raj: ACK. Will create an adhoc alert for sequence-length > 256 during canaries and add a temporary filter to route long seq requests away from canaries.

emily: thanks all. Closing thread once postmortem link posted. :thumbsup:
